in_sanskrit.name: धनजी
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: धन (dhan) means wealth or money, and जी (ji) is a suffix that denotes a person. So, Dhanaji means 'a wealthy person' in Sanskrit.

in_hindi.name: धनजी
in_hindi.meaning: धन (dhan) means wealth or money, and जी (ji) is a suffix that denotes a person. So, Dhanaji means 'a wealthy person' in Hindi as well.

in_tamil.name: தன்னாஜி
in_tamil.meaning: தன் (tan) means self, and ஞா (nja) means wealth. So, Tan-naja means 'self-wealthy' in Tamil.
in_tamil.long_meaning: An alternative interpretation of Tan-naja is 'one who possesses wealth within oneself'. In this context, ஞா (nja) can also mean 'inner self' or 'soul'. So, Tan-naja can also mean 'one who has wealth in his soul'.

in_telugu.name: దన్నజి
in_telugu.meaning: దన్న (dannu) means wealth, and జీ (ji) is a suffix that denotes a person. So, Dannaju means 'a wealthy person' in Telugu.

in_marathi.name: Dhanaji
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhanaji हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhanaji is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'dhan', which means 'wealth' or 'prosperity'. The suffix 'ji' is a title of respect. In Hindu mythology, Dhanaji could be named after Lord Dhanvantari, the god of Ayurvedic medicine and the protector of health and prosperity.
